# Lists Web Components

React Web Components implementing Material design.

# Overview

This is a monorepo (a single repository that contains multiple projects), made up of front end components and modules.

# Installation

```bash
$ git clone git@gitlab.joltup.com:jolt/lists.git
$ npm install
```

### Setup Requestly

after install use [Requestly](https://www.requestly.in/rules/) to setup any redirects to use staging as your backend using the **Replace Host** method:

Requestly rules have been defined in this project.
Simply upload them to your chrome extension.

# Running Docs

```bash
$ npm start
```

In your browser navigate to [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3001/)

## Publishing a New Version


#### 1. Check the Current Version

Run the following to get the latest published version:

```bash
npm info @joltup/lists-web-components version
```

---

#### 2. Update the Version Number

Use [semantic versioning](https://www.jvandemo.com/a-simple-guide-to-semantic-versioning/) to decide how to bump the version:

- **Patch** for bug fixes (`x.y.z` → `x.y.z+1`)
- **Minor** for backward-compatible feature additions (`x.y.z` → `x.y+1.0`)
- **Major** for breaking changes (`x.y.z` → `x+1.0.0`)

_Example:_  
If the current version is `2.1.2` and you've made a backward-compatible bug fix, the new version should be `2.1.3`.

Go to [`lists-web-components/package.json`](./package.json) and update the `"version"` field with the new version number.

---

#### 3. (After Merge) Tag and Push the New Version Tag

Once your ticket has been merged to master, tag your branch with the new version and push up the tag:

```bash
git tag @joltup/lists-web-components@2.1.3
git push origin @joltup/lists-web-components@2.1.3
```

CI will handle the rest and publish the package if all checks pass.

**Note:** this tag also publishes `@joltup/shared-dev-utils` at the same version. Keep `lists-web-components` and `shared-dev-utils` changes aligned for each release tag.
